# Angira Shukla

Hi! I'm a first-year PhD student at the Kenneth C. Griffin Department of Economics at the University of Chicago. My research interests are development economics, political economy, and environmental economics. Prior to this, I worked at the Becker Friedman Institute as a predoc with Oeindrila Dube. I've designed behavioral experiments and RCTs, and worked with satellite and geospatial data and large-scale administrative datasets.

Before Chicago, I did my master's in International and Development Economics at the University of San Francisco and my bachelor's in Economics from Ramjas College, University of Delhi.
